about_the_game:
Enter the alluringly shy world of Mina, the book-smart librarian whose reserved exterior hides a world of suppressed desires. This DLC expands Model Casting with Mina's unique narrative, seductive encounters, and explicit adult scenarios. Engage Mina through intimate interviews, gradually uncovering her hidden fantasies and playful side. Each dialogue choice brings you closer to unlocking her passionate nature, creating an enticing journey filled with surprise and intimacy.

Key Features:

  • Exclusive Character: Mina, a nerdy librarian with quietly kinky fantasies.

  • Three Captivating Chapters: The Interview, Lewd Meeting, and Lewd Visit (Sandbox).

  • Tailored H-scenes: Explicit scenes carefully designed to reflect Mina's suppressed desires.

  • Seductive Dialogue: Deepen your relationship through intimate conversations.

  • High Replayability: Different dialogue paths unlock new explicit content.

content_descriptors.notes:
Model Casting is an adult visual novel designed for mature audiences and features explicit sexual content, nudity, and strong language. Players interact with fictional characters in scenarios that include suggestive photoshoots, intimate dialogues, and consensual sexual encounters. All characters depicted in the game are 18 years or older.

The mature content is presented as part of the storyline and character development, focusing on consensual relationships and mutual respect. The game does not include depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual acts, extreme violence, self-harm, or drug/alcohol abuse. Instead, it aims to provide an immersive, character-driven experience that explores adult themes in a thoughtful and engaging manner.
